question: How will my career go, and when is the best time for a job change?

drafts.summary: The Sun and Mercury together in the 10th house form both Budhaditya yoga and a kendra-trikona Raja yoga [rule:yoga.budhaditya] [rule:yoga.kendra_trikona_raja]. Most signal families lean for career, led by an exalted Venus as Amatyakaraka [vote:career.karaka]. The KP reading of the 10th cusp, through its sub-lord Ketu in the 8th, is the one family against [vote:career.kp].

claims.text: The Sun, lord of the 4th, joins Mercury, lord of the 5th, in the 10th house: a kendra lord with a trikona lord, neither owning the 6th, 8th or 12th [rule:yoga.kendra_trikona_raja] [text:BPHS/Santhanam-1984/34/11-12] [text:BPHS/Santhanam-1984/34/15].
The Sun and Mercury share Aquarius, the 10th house, which forms Budhaditya yoga, with Mercury at 0°22' in Bala avastha [rule:yoga.budhaditya] [text:Phaladeepika/Sastri-1937/18/1].

Mars in its own sign Scorpio, a kendra from the lagna, forms Ruchaka yoga, scaled down by Saturn's aspect, the Pratyak tara and Marana Karaka Sthana [rule:yoga.ruchaka] [text:BPHS/Santhanam-1984/75/1-2].
Counted from the Sun, Mars sits in the 10th house, so Ruchaka yoga also forms from the Sun [rule:yoga.ruchaka] [text:Phaladeepika/Sastri-1937/6/1].
By Bhava Bala the 10th house itself is the weakest of the twelve at 4.51 rupas, but the career houses read together from the lagna, the Moon and the Sun still lean for career [vote:career.house].

Among the career lords, Venus, lord of the 6th, is exalted in the 11th and Mars, lord of the 7th, holds its own sign, which outweighs Saturn, lord of the 10th, in a friend's sign in the 1st at a Shadbala ratio of 0.69, and Jupiter, lord of the 11th, in an enemy's sign [vote:career.lord].
Venus, the Amatyakaraka, is exalted with a Shadbala ratio of 1.33 and carries the karaka vote for career, while the Sun in an enemy's sign weighs against it [vote:career.karaka].
In the D10, Venus, Saturn and Mars keep dignities that agree with their D1 standing while the Sun and Jupiter do not, so the varga family leans narrowly for career [vote:career.varga].
The sub-lord of the 10th cusp is Ketu, which sits in the 8th house and owns no house, so the KP family votes against career [vote:career.kp].

Mars, lord of the birth tithi and nakshatra, and the Moon, lord of the weekday, are both career lords counted from one of the three lagnas and both exceed their required Shadbala, so the panchanga family votes for career [vote:career.panchanga].
